The downward-scroll check at $0CCC–$0CD9 compares the next map-row position with this value.
The little-endian address $A5E6 of this load’s entity records. $1863 copies it into the pointer at $E2–$E3.

A 256-byte lookup indexed by screen character value. The resident code at $6F59–$6F5F reads a character from the selected screen buffer and writes the corresponding table byte to colour RAM. The table continues across $8000.
Continuation of the character-to-colour lookup beginning at $7FCF; this byte is entry $31 of that table, and entries continue through $80CE.

A 256-byte attribute table indexed by the map's metatile value. The downward movement check at $0C57 tests bits 0–1, and the horizontal movement checks at $0EB8 and $1051 test bit 1 when clipping the player against a tile.
A 256-byte table of top-left character codes indexed by a metatile value. The resident draw loop at $6D4D writes the selected code to the first cell of a two-by-two screen block.
A 256-byte table of top-right character codes indexed by a metatile value. The resident draw loop at $6D53 writes the selected code to the cell to the right of the first cell.
A 256-byte table of bottom-left character codes indexed by a metatile value. The resident draw loop at $6D5A writes the selected code one 40-character screen row below the first cell.
A 256-byte table of bottom-right character codes indexed by a metatile value. The resident draw loop at $6D60 writes the selected code one row below and one cell to the right of the first cell.

Load 29 update entry: load X from $4DBD and write $10 to $4DCB,X. It jumps to $0732 when column $6F3C equals $2E; otherwise it jumps to $0200. Before that test, values of $4DB5 at least $05 are set to $04. The entry bytes also belong to the captured character-copy source. The entry was not reached in that bounded capture; the description follows the loaded code and controlled tests. The conditions are tested with controlled inputs; this does not establish a natural route to them.

Load 29 trigger record 1 of 1: initial bytes $FF, $FF, $FF, $FF, $00, $00. $7979 copies the fields to the column, row, remaining-count, argument and callback arrays; the initial callback address is $0000. $48BF compares the stored column and row with the view tile, checks and decrements the count, then dispatches through the callback. Other code can change the stored count.

Load 29 stage object record 1 of 2: initial bytes $05, $08, $01, $01, $00, $00, $00, $00, $00, $00, $40, $8F, $2F, $30, $3C, $3D. $4655 copies the first 12 fields to per-record arrays and the final four to $7D–$80, then calls $46D6. That map updater can replace those four bytes according to the fourth field and world mode before writing cells. The captured record does not establish that ordinary play reaches its later behavior.

Store A as a byte counter at $978F. Patch the low operand of the indexed store at $977A from X and its high operand from $46, then set X=0. The patched absolute indexed address can cross a page.
